title: $5 off $50, $10 off $80 or $15 off $100 on Selected Products @ YIZHUO (+ Delivery)
body:
Deal: $5 off $50, $10 off $80 or $15 off $100 on Selected Products @ YIZHUO (+ Delivery)

[Lizard Spock] That's some interesting random products you have there…
[HarrisonW] Haha, fair point! We carry a mix of everyday essentials and other finds. Thanks for having a look!
[Lizard Spock] Maybe list which products you consider are an actual bargain. I've checked a couple of your products and your prices (even after the discount) is comparable to Amazon (provided you have prime) and some cheaper on eBay.
[HarrisonW] Fair feedback. A coupon on its own doesn't show which items are a good deal, and we shouldn't imply every item is cheaper than Amazon or eBay. Specific examples with the final delivered price would make this post more useful. Thanks for taking the time to compare and explain.
[carrawa] May be a spiel in the description of your products/ range.
[QuickToThePointless] why is your bust cream line in both the food AND drinks
sections?
and why would my dog need a Dove Beauty Cream Bar ?
I have never seen such nonsense in my local retailer!
[Lizard Spock] Bust cream, in food and drinks!? This party is going to be off the hook!
[QuickToThePointless] at $36 for a 12 pack of Dr Pepper or Root Beer, it would be cheaper to load the party with the party with a block of VB
[HarrisonW] Thanks for pointing this out. I've checked the Food collection and can confirm the bust cream is incorrectly listed there. That's a categorisation error, not an intended use of the product. Sorry for the confusing browsing experience, and thank you for flagging it.
[QuickToThePointless] (spits out bust cream)
can i have a Dr Pepper to rinse my mouth?
